documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, November 03, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited announced its Q1 FY27 financial results, reporting a 144.69% year-on-year revenue growth to INR 716.38 crores and EBITDA of INR 71.45 crores. The company commenced operations at its new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai, and is expanding further with an upcoming plant in Jaipur. Management reiterated its full-year revenue growth guidance of 50% to 60% and volume growth target of 30% to 40%. Additionally, the board approved a rights issue of up to INR 100 crores to fund inventory and working capital requirements. Shanti Gold International Limited published its Q1 FY27 investor presentation, reporting revenue from operations of ₹716.38 crore compared to ₹292.78 crore in Q1 FY26.

guidance.claim: The company expects top line value growth of 50% to 60% for the full year.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

guidance.claim: Management targets annual volume growth in the range of 30% to 40% compared to last year.
guidance.quote: So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects sustainable EBITDA margin to be in the range of 7.5% to 8%.
guidance.quote: EBITDA margin would be around 7.5% to 8%.

guidance.claim: Management targets a PAT margin of around 4%.
The company expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the sustainable net profit margin is around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

guidance.claim: The company expects a turnover of around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores next year.
guidance.quote: So next year like around we expecting a turnover of around INR 3,000 crores to INR 3,500 crores and with 35% to 40% growth.

guidance.claim: Management stated that exports are expected to go up from 10% to 20% or maybe more.
guidance.quote: So I told you like this year will be like from 5% to we are going to go up to 10% or maybe more. Sorry, from 10% to 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: India's jewellery market demand is driven by weddings, occasions, rising disposable incomes, and preference for organized brands.
demand_outlook.quote: India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported strong demand across export and local markets following recent industry exhibitions.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is, as I said, we just exhibited from the exhibition and we've come and we have a huge demand in export as well as in local.

demand_outlook.claim: Seasonal demand in the Indian gold jewellery market is driven by weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals.
demand_outlook.quote: Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that despite elevated gold prices, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness healthy transactions particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Organized jewellers and retailers continue to show an increasing outsourcing preference to focus on footprint expansion and faster design cycles.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that India remains one of the world's largest consumers of gold jewellery supported by cultural affinity and rising disposable incomes.
demand_outlook.quote: India remains one of the world's largest consumers of gold jewellery, strongly supported by strong cultural affinity, rising disposable incomes, wedding demands, and increasing preference for branded jewellery at the same time.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations commenced at the company's new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The company allocated around INR 47 crores capex for its Jaipur facility, which is expected to be operational around November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur factory is spread across 3 acres of land, with the initial phase covering 50,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during the IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Marol factory is expected to start in a month or so, while the Jaipur factory should start by around September or October.
capex_expansion.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached INR 71.45 crores, reflecting a 39% year-on-year increase.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at INR71.45 crores, as compared to INR51.41 crores in Q1 FY26, registering a growth of 39% Y-o-Y.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 9.97 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Unrealized inventory gains from inventory valuation change contributed roughly 2% to 2.5% to the Q1 EBITDA margin.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for the quarter stood at 7.05%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for the quarter stood at 7.05 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Higher production improves fixed-cost absorption and manufacturing efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: Higher production improves fixed-cost absorption and manufacturing efficiency

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 67.01 crores, with EBITDA margins improving by 306 basis points to 10.17%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q4 FY26 stood at INR 67.01 crores as compared to INR 21.12 crores in Q4 FY25, registering a growth of 217.26% Y-oY. EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 7.88% compared to 3.09% in Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for the quarter stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from FIFO to the weighted average cost method effective April 01, 2024.
margins_costs.quote: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from the First In, First Out, FIFO method to the weighted average cost WAC method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the existing Mumbai facility is currently at 75%.
Installed capacity post-commissioning across Andheri and Marol stands at approximately 6,700 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity will reach 7,900 kg per annum upon completion of the Jaipur facility.
Current capacity utilization at existing facilities is around 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company approved a rights issue of up to 46,43,471 equity shares aggregating up to INR 100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Funds raised from the rights issue will be deployed entirely into gold purchases and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's debt-to-equity ratio currently stands at 0.50 and management intends to maintain it below 1.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: The company highlights a steadily deleveraging balance sheet alongside improving returns.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistently improving returns and a steadily deleveraging balance sheet signal strong fundamental momentum

capital_allocation.claim: The company successfully completed its IPO and got listed in August 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Most notably, we successfully completed our IPO, and got listed in August 2025, marking an important milestone in our growth journey.
Yes, and as far as the value again, if you see the metrics also, my debt-equity is at 0.36.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on capital employed (ROCE) is at a healthy level of 38%.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as the ROCE and everything is concerned it still is at a very healthy margin of say I think 38%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operating cash flow remains negative as the company maintains readily available stock rather than operating solely on an order-to-order basis.
risks_headwinds.quote: The reason for being negative cash flow is like, we utilize all the funds and we keep the stock readily.

risks_headwinds.claim: Expansion across regions, products, and export markets helps lower concentration risk.
risks_headwinds.quote: Expansion across regions, products, and export markets reduces concentration risk

risks_headwinds.claim: Incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended due to geopolitical situations and ongoing wars in the region.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: Management maintains its commitment to achieve 50% to 60% top line growth for the year.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

management_commitments.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility is planned to become operational by November or December.
management_commitments.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to creating sustainable long-term value for stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: We deeply value your confidence in our journey and remain committed to creating sustainable long-term value.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to offering differentiated designs and superior product quality while maintaining consistency in execution.
management_commitments.quote: we remain deeply committed to offering differentiated designs and superior product quality to contemporary designs, while maintaining consistency in execution while continuing to drive repeat business and customer stickiness.

management_commitments.claim: The company's priority is to scale responsibly, deepen customer relationships, strengthen the product portfolio, and expand geographical reach.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, our priority remains clear to scale responsibly, deepen customer relationships, strengthen the product portfolio, expand our geographical reach, and continue creating sustainable long-term relationships for all our stakeholders.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
